page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7nex.16xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8369B processors operating at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU core.

This server type does not include bundled local storage or integrated GPU hardware. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline network bandwidth of 80 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included with the instance.

Given the 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the hardware profile is tailored for compute-intensive workloads rather than memory-heavy applications. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance. This configuration is suitable for workloads such as high-performance web serving, batch processing, and compute-heavy distributed systems where local storage is not a primary requirement.
